reviews.title: Nice case
reviews.comment: good small case, decent airflow, cable management is easy but depends on wether or not you have the time, easy to install however the thermaltake 360 aio does not fit with the tubes at the bottom ( the tubes at the top works fine), nice weight, and quiet.
reviews.author: woful

reviews.title: Nice, accessible case with lots of fan space
reviews.comment: Comes with 3 fans, I'm currently using 5 but could fit another one or maybe 2 if I move my video card. Easy M.2 drive access, easy PSU installation, room for a couple of SSDs, I also have an older 4TB HDD with plenty of room. The lights are programmable and the wiring might be a little confusing for a beginner, but if you're building your own PC, you'll figure it out. Not the largest case, but very open inside, lots of room and good air flow, just keep it clean of dust and cat hair.
reviews.author: kurt

reviews.title: The ARGB never worked
reviews.comment:
The case it pretty good.  Easy to get into, easy to close.  It was heavier than my old case, but not much and it vents a lot better and looks classier.
Could not get the fans to light up.  But I also don’t really care.  I’m honestly not sure why I’d want it anyway.  I don’t really need light up appliances.

reviews.title: Great pc case
reviews.comment: Great case for my pc with a mini motherboard. Compact but plenty of space for cables managment and clean as hell looking.

reviews.title: Beautiful case and great design
reviews.comment: Another great product that is built well and looks amazing. Fits a full atx board or smaller perfectly. Very solid and great cable routing channels. Fans are quiet and balanced. Excellent airflow. You're missing out without this!
